retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, two-tone portrait where the subject is rendered as a solid silhouette filled with a vertical color gradient against a stark white background.
excludeWhen: soft lighting or realistic skin tones are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist graphic portrait featuring a male profile in sunglasses, characterized by extreme contrast that eliminates mid-tones, filled with a smooth vertical gradient transitioning from deep blue to vibrant red, set against a clean white negative space.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject silhouette vs stark white negative space
Vertical color gradient vs high-contrast halftone texture
Sharp profile edges vs grainy interior details
Cool blue top vs warm red bottom
coreInvariants: The subject must be rendered as a high-contrast graphic with no mid-tones, using only the gradient colors and the background color.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the left third, facing right, cropped at the torso and top of the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The face in profile, specifically the sunglasses and jawline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical gradient from the blue head down the red torso, then follows the subject's gaze to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white space on the right half of the frame creates balance and focus.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the gradient colors contrasting with the zero-saturation white background.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white profile portrait of a man in sunglasses against a white background. Apply a vertical linear gradient overlay transitioning from blue at the top to red at the bottom, ensuring the gradient only affects the black areas of the image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If text is needed, use a clean, bold sans-serif font in either pure white or one of the gradient extremes, positioned in the negative space on the right.

verificationChecks: Is the subject rendered without mid-tones?
Does the gradient transition smoothly from blue to red vertically?

mustRedesign: Multi-color palettes beyond the duotone gradient
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no photographic detail remains in the shadows
Verify vertical orientation of the gradient
Confirm the subject is cropped off-center
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast [Subject] profile + vertical [Color 1] to [Color 2] gradient + white negative space + halftone texture.
